title: AI Engineering Hub
summary: A large collection of AI engineering tutorials and agent applications; one subproject, sdv-mcp, is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that exposes synthetic data generation as a callable agent tool. It loads a CSV folder's Metadata, fits an SDV HMASynthesizer, samples synthetic data, and evaluates quality, packaging SDV's multi-table synthesis as an agent-invoked skill.
needs: sdv-mcp is one small subfolder of a large multi-tutorial hub; broader repo relevance to SDV is limited to this single MCP tool.
